# Read-only overlay check — 2026-10-27

**Static-scene gate failed; joint-offset fitting was stopped before any sweep.** The back table/wall edge aligns within about 2 px, but the box front-bottom edge differs by 4–7 px in all 26 unobstructed comparisons. Two further box comparisons are occluded. These data do not certify a common camera/scene alignment. They do not isolate camera pose as the cause: box size, placement, or scene geometry can also explain the mismatch.

**The wrist-roll action gap is explained by the recorder’s sim-only wrist re-zero transform.** It is essentially constant within each episode, with eight shift levels across recording groups. It is not evidence for a follower mapping correction.

**The physical gripper closed angle remains unverified.** The existing CAD contact-proxy calculation crosses zero near -12.931°, while the USD lower stop is −10.000004°. A proxy zero is not measured jaw-to-jaw contact. The camera gate and missing eligible fully closed reference prevent choosing a physical closed angle from this experiment. No mapping or limit change is recommended or made.

## Scope and branch

Fetched `origin`; verified that `origin/calibration-fixes` contains the import fix `b6ed4e6`; fast-forwarded `calibration-fixes` from `c2c9896` to `b6ed4e6597386f21fad9e6b70000c42f83323e8c`. No new commit, push, or merge commit was made. No hardware was opened. Analysis helpers and intermediates were written only under `/tmp/so101-overlay-check`; the repository outputs are this report and PNGs in this directory. Protected inputs were mounted read-only in the renderer.

## Selected frames and actual rendered poses

Used **follower `observation.state` from `datasets/pick_place_v1-real`**, never its action, to pose the robot. The mapping was regenerated through `utils/joint_calibration.follower_mapping_from_calibration` from the stored follower ranges and the current gripper anchor, and checked for exact equality with `sim_joint_mapping`. Rendering used the unchanged Pick-Place room and wrist camera configuration via `SceneReplayer`, with no physics stepping during posing and no camera or joint-offset fitting. The cube pose was a paired sim sidecar proxy and was not used as a camera landmark.

Of 16,448 real frames, 11,359 are inside **all six exact USD limits**. There are 2,665 quiet frames overall and 630 quiet in-limit candidates across 55 episodes. Selected **28 frames across 28 episodes** using pose diversity and the eligible gripper/roll extremes.

Quiet means every joint changes by at most 0.25° between adjacent samples and has at most 0.5° total excursion in a centered five-frame window (133 ms at 30 FPS). The maximum instantaneous finite-difference speed under this rule is 7.5°/s; these are nearly stationary windows, not a claim of perfect hardware synchronization.

The maximum difference between the requested unclipped mapped pose and the actual simulator joint positions across all 28 renders was **0.00001698°**. None of the selected baseline poses needed clamping.

The absolute gripper state minimum is **1.423729 units at episode 23, frame 187**. That frame is in-limit but has about 25.49° shoulder-lift and 22.50° elbow excursion over the five-frame window; it is excluded for motion. The minimum eligible quiet gripper state is **5.627119 units**, so it cannot be labeled a fully closed reference. The fully open and maximum-roll global samples also do not satisfy the combined stillness/limit filter. Eligible extremes were used instead; global endpoints were not quietly substituted into the fit.

| Joint | Global real-state min/max, units | Selected min/max, units |

| shoulder_pan | -96.276993 / 79.970215 | -94.043190 / 74.981384 |

## Camera check before any joint fit

The gate was a maximum 3 px median displacement for the box front-bottom edge and the back table/wall edge, checked separately in each selected frame. This is deliberately stricter than allowing a several-pixel scene error to be absorbed by 1° joint sweeps. No image translation, rotation, homography, or registration was applied.

The sim box mask came from `instance_id_segmentation_fast` using its WhiteBox prim labels. The real white box was extracted by a fixed HSV threshold (saturation <85, value >145) in a fixed front-face ROI; the front-bottom edge was measured over the same 90 image columns. Two frames (episode 29/frame 91 and episode 38/frame 60) are explicitly marked unmeasurable because the white arm occludes/joins the box component. Their spurious colour-component edges were discarded after visual inspection, not treated as camera measurements. The back edge uses the cyan-wall to brown-table chroma transition in two fixed unobstructed strips.

For the 26 usable box edges: median real-minus-sim displacement **6.0 px**, range **4.0–7.0 px**. For the back table/wall edge: median **0.0 px**, range **-2.0–1.0 px**. There are **0 passes, 26 static-scene failures, and 2 unverified box comparisons**. A distinct mat border and the front table edge are not visible as independent landmarks in these chosen views.

Wrist images are included for every frame. Their background box/table projection is not independently certified: wrist world pose depends on the arm pose, and the mount extrinsics are unverified. Several overlays show substantial box-edge tilt/position differences. This is supporting evidence of an unresolved projection discrepancy only, and was not converted into a wrist-roll fit.

## Gripper: −10° versus about −13°

No wrist-camera jaw-offset fit was performed. The absolute fully closed sample fails the all-joint stillness rule, the current USD stop is not a separate jaw-contact measurement, and the camera/scene gate did not pass. Fixed-jaw, mount, lens, pad, and mesh differences remain possible confounders.

For context only, recomputed the **existing diagnostic contact-point** gap by analytic USD joint-frame FK without changing any asset, state mapping, or limit. These points come from `_tip_offsets(..., half_size=0.01)`: they represent cube-contact locations, not a full mesh collision/contact solver or physical soft-pad measurement.

| USD jaw angle | Signed proxy gap, mm |
|---|---|
| -19.000000° | -6.970753 |
| -13.000000° | -0.081194 |
| -10.000004° | 3.484225 |
| -8.154301° | 5.711951 |
| 0.000000° | 15.800034 |

The proxy reaches zero at **-12.930983°**, **2.930979° below the unchanged USD lower limit**. This supports why ‘about −13°’ is a geometric hypothesis, but does not establish where the real jaws touch. It is not a fitted closed-angle result or a recommendation to change a limit.

![CAD contact-proxy calculation](jaw_contact_proxy.png)

## Paired actions: every frame and every joint

Aligned all **16,448 frame pairs** by `(episode_index, frame_index)`, checked equal keys/timestamps, and computed `delta = sim.action − real.action` independently of either state column. The following statistics use all frame pairs, not episode means.

| Joint | Mean Δ | Std Δ | Min Δ | Max Δ | Frames with \|Δ\| > 0.0001 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| shoulder_pan | 0.003965943 | 0.078935765 | -0.000022888 | 2.221275330 | 53 |
| shoulder_lift | -0.000001871 | 0.000005006 | -0.000022888 | 0.000015259 | 0 |
| elbow_flex | -0.000000936 | 0.000007440 | -0.000038147 | 0.000022888 | 0 |
| wrist_flex | -0.000002485 | 0.000008900 | -0.000038147 | 0.000030518 | 0 |
| wrist_roll | 3.754594925 | 1.879536195 | 1.445402145 | 7.062026978 | 16448 |
| gripper | -0.000000505 | 0.000001652 | -0.000011444 | 0.000007629 | 0 |

The wrist gap is **not one constant shift across the whole dataset** and **not a genuine scale difference**. Within each episode it is constant to float32 precision; group means range from 1.4454 to 7.0620 units. Pooled regression misleadingly gives slope 0.978553 because shift levels correlate with different recorded poses. After subtracting each episode’s shift, the residual is **5.79523975e-06 units RMS**, maximum **3.01594731e-05 units**.

The other-joints-identical statement needs one qualification: shoulder pan has **53 clipped frames**. The historical sim normalized-to-degrees conversion clamps to the old USD pan limit before its inverse; applying that clamp to the paired real actions predicts sim pan with maximum residual 2.28881836e-05 units. Lift, elbow, wrist flex, and gripper have only float32 roundoff differences.

## How the paired data was produced

- `pick_place_v1-real/meta/info.json` identifies a 30 FPS LeRobot v3 follower dataset, 75 episodes, 16,448 frames, with real `external` and `gripper` videos and follower state/action features. There is no real `pick_place_meta/` cube-trajectory sidecar directory or real replay manifest.
- Historical `utils/recording_setup.py` at `847b169` derives the physical recorder’s root by appending `-real` to the sim root and supplies real-camera features. The paired recorder saves the real follower observation and the raw leader action.
- Historical `scripts/pick_place_agent.py` at `847b169`, lines 481–496, applies `sim_wrist_start + mapped_leader_wrist − leader_wrist_start` **only to the simulation target**. Lines 520–535 save its inverse-mapped action to sim while saving the unshifted `leader_action` and `follower_observation` to real. The real follower is sent that unshifted leader action. The re-zero is initialized once and reset on an explicit environment reset, explaining why multiple episodes share a level; re-recording can also put a level into noncontiguous episode IDs. The exact sessions/reset events were not logged in the dataset.
- `pick_place_v1/meta/dr_replay_manifest.json` says this sim dataset was re-rendered from `pick_place_v1-old` at commit `847b169f04f5380a21f64dc66e1eef6494880ec1`, blue cube, no DR, no exclusions. Historical `dr_replay.py` lines 167–175 pose source states, render images, and copy source actions/states unchanged. The current sim actions are **numerically identical** to `pick_place_v1-old` actions across all 16,448 frames (maximum numerical difference 0).
- `docker/real/scripts/` contains calibration/check/manual-control utilities and historical real rollout clients. No evidence in the real dataset metadata links those scripts to a separate wrist action relabel. The directly matching paired-recording path above does apply the required sim-only transform.
- Commit `12b2336` added calibration loading to the separate policy rollout client and saved Molmo wrist-frame experiments. Its changes do not regenerate the paired 75-episode dataset or modify recorder/replay actions. The on-disk raw recordings predate it; it is not the source of this roll gap.

**Conclusion on pairing:** the observed roll gap comes from the sim-side recording re-zero, retained by the subsequent image-only replay. It requires no mapping change to account for that gap. The separate question of absolute physical wrist zero remains unverified because the visual fitting gate failed.

Source references: [historical recorder](https://github.com/iampa1teja/Sim-To-Real/blob/847b169f04f5380a21f64dc66e1eef6494880ec1/source/sim_to_real_so101/scripts/pick_place_agent.py#L481), [historical replay](https://github.com/iampa1teja/Sim-To-Real/blob/847b169f04f5380a21f64dc66e1eef6494880ec1/source/sim_to_real_so101/scripts/dr_replay.py#L167), [recording setup](../../../source/sim_to_real_so101/utils/recording_setup.py), [current shared calibration](../../../source/sim_to_real_so101/utils/joint_calibration.py).

## What could not be verified

- A per-joint physical zero correction, best offset, constrained/flat IoU curve, or two-pass coordinate-descent result: deliberately not fitted after the camera gate failed.
- Actual real-jaw touching angle, −10° versus about −13°: the proxy zero is not a physical-contact measurement, and a fully closed quiet reference satisfying every requested filter is absent.
- Global real gripper maximum and wrist-roll maximum in the selected set: they do not satisfy the combined quiet/in-limit constraints. The report gives global and eligible endpoint values separately.
- Whether the box mismatch is camera extrinsics/intrinsics, box dimensions, box placement, or another static-scene discrepancy. Back-edge alignment alone cannot resolve that.
- Independent wrist-mount extrinsics or a wrist-roll correction from wrist-image tilt; supporting overlays only.
- A distinct mat boundary or front table edge in these views.
- Exact camera/encoder hardware synchronization, historical follower/calibration version, and reset/session identities: the dataset does not persist that run metadata.
- A conclusive camera alignment measurement for the two box-occluded frames.

## Read-only verification

Before/after SHA-256 snapshots of both original datasets and every file under `source/sim_to_real_so101/assets/` were compared. They match. Tracked repository files are unchanged at `b6ed4e6`; only this output directory is new. No calibration file, USD file, dataset, real setup, limit, mapping, source code, or model weight was edited; no commit or push was made.
